keyEvents.text: Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is shown the red card.
Archie Gray (Tottenham Hotspur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Tottenham Hotspur 1, Crystal Palace 0. Archie Gray (Tottenham Hotspur) header from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Mohammed Kudus with a cross following a corner.
First Half ends, Tottenham Hotspur 1, Crystal Palace 0.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Pedro Porro replaces Archie Gray.
Óscar Mingueza (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Eddie Nketiah replaces Yéremy Pino.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Anan Khalaili replaces Óscar Mingueza.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Conor Gallagher replaces Dominic Solanke.
Goal! Tottenham Hotspur 2, Crystal Palace 0. Jan Paul van Hecke (Tottenham Hotspur) header from very close range to the centre of the goal following a corner.
keyEvents.shortText: Jan Paul van Hecke Goal - Header

keyEvents.text: Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Destiny Udogie replaces Andy Robertson.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Dejan Kulusevski replaces Omar Marmoush.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Darío Osorio replaces Dwight McNeil.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Luca Williams-Barnett replaces Mathys Tel.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Will Hughes replaces Daichi Kamada.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Jefferson Lerma replaces Adam Wharton.
